findings.evidence: No `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Symmetric/SpechtIdeal.lean` exists at the PR head; `Relabel.lean:8` had to change its former import to `.Basic`.
findings.fix: Restore `SpechtIdeal.lean` as a compatibility umbrella that publicly imports `SpechtIdeal.Basic` (and optionally `Extremes`).
findings.issue: Renaming this public module to `SpechtIdeal.Basic` makes every downstream `import TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.Symmetric.SpechtIdeal` fail.

findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 90 and 105 have no automation attribute, while the existing analogous membership characterizations `mem_rowSubgroup` and `mem_colSubgroup` are `@[simp]`.
findings.issue: The characteristic normal forms `rowSubgroup_eq_top_iff` and `colSubgroup_eq_top_iff` are not tagged `@[simp]`, so simplification cannot reduce the extreme-group hypotheses to diagram conditions.

summary: The module move breaks the existing public import path, and the new shape-characterization lemmas lack normal-form automation.
